extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 500 BBL insulated frac tank used for?
faqs.a: A frac tank stores fracturing fluid and water at the well site. This 500 BBL tank has an insulated shell, internal baffling, top and side manholes, a vent, and fill and drain lines, on a road-registered custom trailer.

faqs.q: What volumes does the 500 BBL insulated frac tank range come in?
faqs.a: Volumes of 100 to 1,000 BBL are standard, and custom volumes are available on request. This listing is the 500 BBL size. State the volume on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Why is the 500 BBL insulated frac tank insulated?
faqs.a: The insulated shell reduces heat gain and loss in the stored fluid, which helps keep fluid temperature stable. An optional heating coil and recirculation manifold can be added.

faqs.q: What lining does the 500 BBL insulated frac tank use?
faqs.a: Wetted parts are lined or unlined depending on fluid chemistry. State the fluid, additives and temperature on the RFQ so the lining is chosen.

faqs.q: How is the 500 BBL insulated frac tank mounted and registered?
faqs.a: It is on a custom trailer with country-of-registration documentation, and an ISO-frame skid variant is available for global container shipping.

faqs.q: What does the 500 BBL insulated frac tank connect to?
faqs.a: It supplies the [hydration unit](/p/frac-hydration-unit-200-bbl-12-12-centrifugal-90-bbl-min-ss316-tote-tanks) and the [frac transfer pumps](/p/frac-transfer-pump-centrifugal-12-12-300-hp-diesel-hydraulic-drive-skid-mounted) through its fill, recirculation and drain lines, with a vent and top and side manholes on the tank. See [frac tanks](/c/frac-tanks).

faqs.q: How does the 500 BBL insulated frac tank differ from a sand silo?
faqs.a: The frac tank stores liquid with insulation and baffling, while the [sand silo](/p/frac-sand-silo-sand-chief-vertical-round-hydraulic-tilt-200-t-capacity-knife-gate-discharge) stores dry proppant and tilts for chute delivery. A frac site needs both.

faqs.q: Where is the 500 BBL insulated frac tank used?
faqs.a: It is used on hydraulic fracturing sites to store water and fracturing fluid. See the guide on [frac and stimulation equipment](/blog/frac-and-stimulation-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for a frac tank quotation?
faqs.a: Send the volume, the fluid and its temperature, the lining requirement, heating and recirculation options, and the registration country or ISO-skid need.

faqs.q: What are the standard dimensions of the 500 BBL insulated frac tank?
faqs.a: The listing gives no fixed external dimensions because the tank is built on a custom trailer and the design varies with insulation and options. Send the road limits of your site and we confirm the trailer dimensions with the quotation.

faqs.q: Can the frac tank be heated?
faqs.a: Yes. An optional heating coil and recirculation manifold are available on the insulated tank. State the fluid temperature you must hold on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 500 BBL insulated frac tank?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 500 BBL insulated frac tank as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
